root: Actually opened all seven fresh full-resolution captures with view_image after the final capture passed.

HouseboatGardenCourt now visibly occupies the turquoise water with its authored quay platform; it is clear of the surrounding high houses and central HUD. The adjacent willow does not obscure its facade.
Repair workshop and learning pavilion remain visibly distinct; their activity props have normal ground size and do not dominate the view.
Tide gate and completed civic project fit the central view with readable HUD and grounded artwork.
German invitation and Joost story have readable text, visible actions and close controls. The travel list uses its intended scroll mask.
Growth is a diagnostic fixture; these views do not establish natural progression pacing, physical input, user art approval or a free-floating boat simulation.

content.observation: Fresh Russian, French and Spanish portrait quest titles wrap into two lines and remain inside the modal. Progress text, gold close X and both action buttons have separate space. The Russian 1366x768 title remains on one line. No clipped labels, missing Cyrillic glyphs, misplaced accents or title/button overlap were observed.

Great Sativadam, the 0-resident count, 0/18 main-quest count and the current-city status button are fully visible in all checked travel images. Portrait preceding rows wrap before their travel buttons. The partly scrolled preceding button at the top is confined to the list viewport and does not obscure Great Sativadam. Gold close controls remain in the header.

Both place choices remain on separate fixed buttons beneath the dark detail viewport in all six fresh Joost captures. Russian captions wrap into three lines in portrait; the French and Spanish learning-dock captions wrap into four. Captions remain inside their button borders with visible padding. At 1366x768 both choices fit on one line. No overlap between the choices or the story viewport was observed.

Name, role, third-chapter title and both progress cards are readable. The French 1366x768 biography includes the corrected sentence with savoir-faire and surveillance quotidienne. Inspected Russian text renders Cyrillic glyphs; French and Spanish accents render without substitute squares.

Gold close controls remain within the modal header, and Joost has a separate back-to-overview control above the detail viewport. Long story content is masked at the lower detail edge; it stays behind that mask and does not cover the fixed choices. The Russian landscape biography also continues below the mask. This is consistent with the independently scrolling layout. Static images do not prove scroll input or tapping behavior.

authoring: All ten listed PNGs were actually opened at original resolution as fresh Game View images from this capture run. SHA256 hashes, complete PNG trailers, 1920x1080 dimensions and capture freshness were checked again before saving this review.

10_houseboat_gardens resolves the previous on-grass placement and apartment occlusion. HouseboatGardenCourt now stands over the existing turquoise canal at the bank, with its whole building, dark boat hull, mooring posts, ladder, roof plants and stone quay platform visible between the HUD areas. Bank trees frame the site without hiding its main front. No visible hovering base, apartment overlap or HUD obstruction of this principal architecture was observed.

The houseboat stone platform occupies a substantial part of the canal width and connects visually to the bank. The composition reads as a fixed berth with a quay platform. This screenshot review does not claim a freely floating boat or water simulation.

07_repair_wharf and 08_learning_dock show visibly distinct persisted choices: a brick repair workshop with tools and an open teaching pavilion with a blue-green roof. Both adjacent activity benches are small and close to their own buildings. The previously excessive child scale and displaced benches are absent from these fresh captures. Main building fronts and base platforms are clear; neighboring rear roof overlaps read as normal depth sorting.

All three 09_completed_project images show their principal architecture and ground platforms completely between the HUD areas. TideGateCommons, SeedQuayHall and CanalArchive retain readable brick, cream, blue-green and brass details. A birch partly overlaps a small side awning of the seed hall, while its main roof and front remain legible. No obvious hovering bases, oversized activity props or construction fence intersections were observed in these project views.

04_community_before shows the fenced TideGateCommons work area at zero residents. 05_community_growing adds walking residents, upgraded surrounding buildings and local work or memory props while the construction fence remains. 09_completed_project_0 removes that fence. Restoration is visibly conveyed by fence, props, tint and surrounding settlement changes; the principal architectural sprite is reused across these states.

10_canals_and_tide_gate clearly shows the lock building and its small enclosed water basin among farm paths. The building and its platform are visible. This particular close-up does not show a broad connecting river; a continuous canal network or water simulation must not be inferred from it.

10_seed_quay retains a minor district-framing reservation: the hall is at the lower centre and its lower front or platform is partly covered by the bottom HUD and image edge. The same hall is fully visible in 09_completed_project_1. These screenshots do not establish a navigation, collider or interaction failure.

No blocking Game View issue was observed in the ten inspected architecture images. This is a technical screenshot review of the named run, and provides neither user artwork approval, a human playthrough, physical touch evidence nor device acceptance. No source files or assets were changed for this review.
campaign: Nach dem tatsächlichen PASS des finalen Waterfront-Captures wurden alle zwölf bestehenden Stadt-Ankunftsbilder und das Great-Sativadam-Ankunftsbild erneut einzeln mit view_image geöffnet und visuell geprüft. Kein Bild wurde allein anhand des vorherigen Sichtprotokolls freigegeben. Die dreizehn erfassten SHA256-Werte wurden nach dieser frischen Sichtprüfung nochmals gegen die unveränderten PNG-Dateien abgeglichen.

Alle dreizehn PNGs sind frisch zum genannten Capture-Lauf und haben 1920 x 1080 Pixel. Stadttitel, oberes HUD mit Geld/Grinder/Einwohnern, Städte-Link, Einstellungsbutton und die vollständige untere Symbolleiste sind sichtbar. Die Stadtnamen stimmen mit den jeweiligen Bildpfaden überein; auch die längeren Titel Green Leaf Village, Saint Mary Ville und Great Sativadam bleiben vollständig lesbar. Die Einwohneranzeige zeigt den diagnostischen Ausbauzustand mit 1842375 Einwohnern.

In den zwölf bisherigen Städten sind Rathaus, Wege, Vegetation, Brunnen, weitere Stadtobjekte und Figuren erkennbar gerendert. Es wurden keine sichtbaren Fehlerdialoge, Ladeabdeckungen, fehlenden Lokalisierungsschlüssel, fehlenden zentralen Stadtgrafiken oder abgeschnittenen HUD-Texte beobachtet.

Die bisherige gemeinsame Ankunftskomposition bleibt in den frisch angesehenen Bildern erkennbar: Felsen bei Big Rock City, die kleine Kiste bei Little Montana, warme Bodentöne bei Cassa Vadela und Golden Flower, grüne Varianten bei Seven Hills/Mark Wood City/Green Leaf Village, violette Architektur bei Purple Garden sowie kupferfarbene bzw. türkisfarbene Akzente bei Skunkfurt, Saint Mary Ville und Great Kushville. In diesen Ansichten wurde kein offensichtlicher Verlust der bestehenden Stadtgrafik beobachtet. Die Städte teilen viele Objekte und eine ähnliche Komposition; dieser Befund behauptet keine vollständig eigenständige Gestaltung jeder Stadt.

Great Sativadam zeigt einen vollständig lesbaren Titel, das kupferfarbene Rathaus mit türkisfarbenen Akzenten, aufgebaute Produktionsgebäude, sichtbare Einwohner und ein Aufgaben-Symbol in der Welt. Auch in dieser frischen Ankunftsansicht wurde kein blockierender Darstellungsfehler beobachtet.

Weltobjekte am unteren und rechten Kamerarand werden zum Teil durch den Bildausschnitt oder die untere Bedienleiste begrenzt. Die Bedienelemente selbst bleiben sichtbar und lesbar. Dies entspricht der betrachteten Ankunftskomposition; es wurde daraus kein blockierender UI-Fehler festgestellt.

Dieser Teilbericht bewertet ausschließlich die dreizehn genannten aktuellen Ankunfts-PNGs. Ein historischer Bildvergleich mit dem Stand vor der Stadtintegration, eine vollständige Kamerafahrt und Interaktionsprüfung wurden nicht vorgenommen. Die Ankunft von Great Sativadam zeigt den versetzten Hausboot-Uferplatz nicht; dessen Detailsichten werden separat geprüft. Die Sichtprüfung belegt daher keine genaue künstlerische Altzustandsabnahme, physische Geräteprüfung, menschlichen Gesamtdurchlauf oder ausdrückliche visuelle Zustimmung des Nutzers.
